description: This file defines the UnifiedLLMGuardrails class which integrates guardrail mechanisms into various hooks surrounding LLM API calls, specifically handling pre-call, post-call, moderation, and streaming response scenarios for the /applyGuardrail endpoint. It leverages multiple internal modules for logging, caching, route processing, and guardrail application logic.

classes.name: UnifiedLLMGuardrails
classes.description: A class designed to incorporate guardrail logic into various stages of the LLM API call lifecycle, including pre-call modification, moderation, post-response validation, and streaming response handling.

methods.name: Union[Exception,str,dict,None] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Executed before the LLM API call, allows modification of input data by applying guardrails based on route and call type.

methods.name: Any async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral )
methods.description: Runs during the call to review input data for policy violations or issues, without modifying the input.

methods.name: Any async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Handles post-response validation, applying guardrails to the output such as policy adherence and content safety.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[ModelResponseStream,None] async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Processes streaming chunks from the LLM response, applying guardrail logic at specified sampling rates, including final aggregate processing at stream end.
